subject: mathematics
concept: Comparing numbers up to 20 using more, fewer, and equal
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student lines up two virtual object groups side by side to see which has more
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the group with more/fewer objects in a pictured pair
exercise.abstract: Student compares two written numbers and states which is greater or if they are equal

misconception_flags: judges quantity by the size/spread of objects rather than the actual count

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
